name: chating
description: Full-stack AI chatbot powered by React, Vite, Express, Tailwind CSS, and the Google Gemini API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
